scanNote:
7-UNITNING TO'RTINChI BETI (51-bet) - GRAMMATIKA.

Yuqorida o'ngda 'Profiles' va KO'K yorliqda oq '7'.

CHAP USTUN:
• OCh KO'K quti, oq katta harflar 'Present Perfect Simple vs Past Simple': • 'We use the PRESENT PERFECT SIMPLE for an action which happened at an unstated time in the past or which started in the past and continues to the present.' To'q sariq qiya: "I HAVE BEEN to Angola. (When? We don't know.)" / 'He HAS BEEN ill for a week. (He was ill last week and he still is.)' • 'We use the PAST SIMPLE for a completed past action which happened at a stated or known time.' 'He WROTE his third novel in 1998. (When? In 1998.)'
14) 'In pairs, use the prompts below to act out similar dialogues, as in the examples.' Qiya: have measles/break a bone/cut yourself badly/have mumps/have chickenpox/burn yourself badly. Ko'k qiya namunalar: • SA: Have you ever had measles? SB: Yes, I have. SA: When? SB: I had measles when I was five. • SA: Have you ever broken a bone? SB: No, I haven't.
15) 'Fill in DID, HAVE or HAS.' Sakkiz savol: 1 ... you enjoy the concert? 2 ... you finished your homework? 3 ... Tracy write this by herself? 4 ... anybody seen my coat? 5 ... you ever been on TV? 6 ... Gordon take the dog out this morning? 7 ... George left me the keys? 8 ... I lock the front door?
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Grammar: Present Perfect Continuous (have/has been + verb -ing)'.
• OCh KO'K quti, oq 'Use': • 'We use the PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS to talk about an action which STARTED IN THE PAST and CONTINUES TO THE PRESENT to give EMPHASIS TO DURATION.' To'q sariq qiya: 'The organisation HAS BEEN SENDING medical teams and equipment to Angola since 1986.' • 'We also use the PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS to talk about a completed past action which has VISIBLE RESULTS in the PRESENT.' "I'm dirty because I'VE BEEN WORKING in the garden."
16) 'Read the article in Ex. 3 again and find the present perfect forms - simple or continuous.'

O'NG USTUN:
17) 'Look at the pictures and match the people to the prompts. What has each person been doing? Make sentences, as in the example.' SURAT (chizma): 1 - ayol stulda o'tirib oyoqlarini tog'orada suvga solgan (charchagan); 2 - ayol kompyuter oldida, ko'zlari charchagan; 3 - uch yigit ko'k mayka, basketbol to'pi bilan; 4 - kombinezonli erkak bo'yoq cho'tkasi va chelak bilan; 5 - xarid xaltalari ko'targan er-xotin. Ko'rsatmalar: • shop/all day • work/all night • walk/all morning • paint/all day • play basketball/all afternoon. Ko'k qiya namuna: '1 She has been walking all morning.'
• OCh KO'K quti, oq 'For · Since': • 'We use FOR to express duration.' "I've been living here FOR twenty years." • 'We use SINCE to state a starting point.' 'He has been studying English SINCE 1997.'
18) 'Fill in FOR or SINCE.' Sakkiz gap.
19) 'Complete the sentences below about yourself.' 1 I've been living here for ...... . 2 I've been studying English since ...... . 3 I've been ...... for/since ...... .
20) 'In pairs, use the prompts to ask and answer questions, as in the example.' Ko'k qiya: SA: How long have you been studying French? SB: I've been studying French for seven years. Olti ko'rsatma: 1 A: How long/you/study/French? B: Seven years. 2 A: How long/you/live/in Hollywood? B: Last August. 3 A: How long/you/drive/racing cars? B: 1982. 4 A: How long/you/wait/here? B: a few minutes 5 A: How long/you/read/that book? B: last month 6 A: How long/you/sunbathe? B: two hours

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '51'.

sections.title: Grammar: Present Perfect vs Past Simple
sections.titleUz: Grammatika: Present Perfect va Past Simple

exercises.instructionEn: Present Perfect Simple vs Past Simple
exercises.instructionUz: Present Perfect Simple va Past Simple
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI ZAMON FARQI - ENG MUHIM MAVZU.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  PRESENT PERFECT                 ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1) VAQTI AYTILMAGAN:
     'I HAVE BEEN to Angola.'
     (Qachon? Bilmaymiz - muhim
      emas)

  2) O'TMIShDA BOShLANIB HOZIR HAM
     DAVOM ETADI:
     'He HAS BEEN ill for a week.'
     (o'tgan hafta kasal edi va
      HALI HAM kasal)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  PAST SIMPLE                     ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  TUGAGAN harakat, VAQTI AYTILGAN
  yoki MA'LUM:
     'He WROTE his third novel in
      1998.' (Qachon? 1998 da)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  TEZ TEKShIRUV                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Gapda ANIQ O'TGAN VAQT bormi?
     (yesterday, last week, in 1998,
      two days ago, when I was five)
     → PAST SIMPLE

  Vaqt yo'q yoki hozirgacha davom
  etadi?
     (ever, never, just, already,
      yet, for, since, so far)
     → PRESENT PERFECT


⚠ O'ZBEKChA BILAN FARQ:

  O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham '-di' /
  '-gan' bilan ifodalanadi:
  'Angolada bo'lganman' (perfect)
  '1998 da yozdi' (past)
  ⚠ Ingliz tilida VAQT belgisi
  zamonni belgilaydi.


⚠ 'A NOVEL':

  = roman.
  ⚠ 'a novelist' = yozuvchi.
exercises.bookRef: Coursebook, 51-bet, Present Perfect vs Past Simple qutisi

points.en: We use the present perfect simple for an action which happened at an unstated time in the past or which started in the past and continues to the present.
points.uz: Present perfect simple ni o'tmishda aytilmagan vaqtda bo'lgan yoki o'tmishda boshlanib hozirgacha davom etayotgan harakat uchun ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz: ⚠ Ikki holat: vaqt yo'q / hali davom etadi.

points.en: I have been to Angola. (When? We don't know.)
He has been ill for a week. (He was ill last week and he still is.)
points.uz: U bir haftadan beri kasal. (O'tgan hafta kasal edi va hali ham kasal.)
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'for a week' - davom etadi.
⚠ 'still' = hali ham.

points.en: We use the past simple for a completed past action which happened at a stated or known time.
points.uz: Past simple ni aytilgan yoki ma'lum vaqtda bo'lgan tugagan o'tmish harakati uchun ishlatamiz.

points.en: He wrote his third novel in 1998. (When? In 1998.)
points.uz: U uchinchi romanini 1998 yilda yozdi. (Qachon? 1998 da.)

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, use the prompts below to act out similar dialogues, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda quyidagi ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing, namunalardagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNALAR:

  SA: Have you ever had measles?
  SB: Yes, I have.
  SA: When?
  SB: I had measles when I was five.

  SA: Have you ever broken a bone?
  SB: No, I haven't.


⚠ IKKI ZAMON BIR DIALOGDA:

  'HAVE you ever HAD ...?' - present
     perfect (tajiba, vaqt yo'q)
  'When?' - vaqt so'raldi
  'I HAD measles WHEN I WAS five.' -
     PAST SIMPLE (vaqt aytildi!)

  ⚠ Bu - ikki zamon farqining ENG
  YAXShI misoli.


⚠ QISQA JAVOBLAR:

  Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
  ⚠ 'Yes, I did' - XATO (savol
  'have' bilan).


⚠ BOLALIK KASALLIKLARI:

  measles - qizamiq
  mumps - tepki
  chickenpox - suvchechak
  ⚠ Hammasi '-s' bilan tugasa ham
  BIRLIK: 'Measles IS ...'
  ⚠ 'HAVE' bilan: 'to have measles'.


⚠ 'YOURSELF':

  'cut YOURSELF', 'burn YOURSELF'
  = o'zingni kesib/kuydirib olmoq.
  ⚠ O'zlik olmoshi.


⚠ 'BADLY':

  = qattiq, jiddiy.
  ⚠ 'cut yourself badly' = qattiq
  kesib olmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in did, have or has.
exercises.instructionUz: did, have yoki has ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOLLARDA YoRDAMChI FE'L.


⚠ QANDAY TANLASh:

  Asosiy fe'l ASOSIY ShAKLDA
  (enjoy, write, take, lock) →
  DID (past simple)

  Asosiy fe'l 3-ShAKLDA (finished,
  seen, been, left) → HAVE/HAS
  (present perfect)

  ⚠ 'has' - he/she/it/anybody/
  George bilan; 'have' - you/they/I
  bilan.


JAVOBLAR:

  1 DID you enjoy - 'enjoy' asosiy
    shakl
  2 HAVE you finished - 'finished'
    3-shakl
  3 DID Tracy write - 'write' asosiy
    shakl
  4 HAS anybody seen - 'seen'
    3-shakl; 'anybody' birlik
  5 HAVE you ever been - 'ever' +
    'been'
  6 DID Gordon take - 'take' + 'this
    morning' (aniq vaqt)
  7 HAS George left - 'left' 3-shakl
  8 DID I lock - 'lock' asosiy shakl


⚠ 'BY HERSELF':

  = o'zi, yolg'iz.
  ⚠ 'by myself/yourself/himself'.


⚠ 'ANYBODY' - BIRLIK:

  'Has anybody seen ...?'
  ⚠ 'anybody', 'anyone', 'somebody'
  - BIRLIK fe'l bilan.


⚠ 'TO TAKE THE DOG OUT':

  = itni sayrga olib chiqmoq.


⚠ 'THIS MORNING' - 6-BANDDA:

  Agar hozir tushdan keyin bo'lsa -
  'this morning' TUGAGAN vaqt →
  past simple.
  ⚠ 'take' asosiy shaklda - demak
  baribir 'did'.

exercises.instructionEn: Present Perfect Continuous (have/has been + verb -ing) — Use
exercises.instructionUz: Present Perfect Continuous (have/has been + fe'l -ing) — Ishlatilishi
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  have/has + BEEN + fe'l-ING

  I HAVE BEEN WORKING
  She HAS BEEN WORKING

  ⚠ 'been' HAR DOIM - shaxsga
  qarab o'zgarmaydi.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  IKKI IShLATILIShI               ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1) O'TMIShDA BOShLANIB HOZIR
     DAVOM ETADI - DAVOMIYLIKKA
     URG'U:
     'The organisation HAS BEEN
      SENDING medical teams since
      1986.'
     (qancha VAQT - muhim)

  2) TUGAGAN, lekin NATIJASI HOZIR
     KO'RINIB TURIBDI:
     "I'm dirty because I'VE BEEN
      WORKING in the garden."
     (kirligim - ishlaganimning
      natijasi)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SIMPLE va CONTINUOUS FARQI      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  SIMPLE - NATIJA / SONI:
     'She HAS TREATED thousands of
      patients.' (nechta - muhim)

  CONTINUOUS - JARAYoN / QANChA
  VAQT:
     'She HAS BEEN TREATING patients
      for eight months.' (qancha
      vaqt - muhim)

  ⚠ 'How many?' → simple
  ⚠ 'How long?' → continuous


⚠ HOLAT FE'LLARI:

  know, like, love, have (egalik),
  be - continuous'da IShLATILMAYDI:
  ✗ 'I have been knowing him'
  ✓ 'I have known him for years'


⚠ 'EMPHASIS':

  = urg'u.
  ⚠ 'to give emphasis to' = urg'u
  bermoq.

points.en: We use the present perfect continuous to talk about an action which started in the past and continues to the present to give emphasis to duration.
points.uz: Present perfect continuous ni o'tmishda boshlanib hozirgacha davom etayotgan harakat haqida gapirish, davomiylikka urg'u berish uchun ishlatamiz.

points.en: The organisation has been sending medical teams and equipment to Angola since 1986.
points.uz: Tashkilot 1986 yildan beri Angolaga tibbiy jamoalar va jihozlar yuborib kelmoqda.

points.en: We also use the present perfect continuous to talk about a completed past action which has visible results in the present.
points.uz: Present perfect continuous ni natijasi hozir ko'rinib turgan tugagan o'tmish harakati uchun ham ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz: ⚠ Harakat tugagan, lekin IZI hozir bor.

points.en: I'm dirty because I've been working in the garden.
points.uz: Men kirman, chunki bog'da ishlab keldim.

exercises.instructionUz: 3-mashqdagi maqolani qayta o'qing va present perfect shakllarini toping - simple yoki continuous.
exercises.explanationUz:
48-BETDAGI MATNDAN.


PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS:
  has been living (in Angola)
  has been sending (medical teams)
  have been fighting (armies)
  has been working (hard)
  has been training (local people)
  have been helping (people)


PRESENT PERFECT SIMPLE:
  have grown (worse and worse)
  have become (a major problem)
  has treated (thousands of
    patients)
  has been (a meaningful experience)
  have never felt (so useful)
  has already decided (to return)


⚠ NEGA ShUNDAY?

  'has TREATED thousands' - NATIJA,
     SONI (simple)
  'has been TRAINING' - JARAYoN,
     davom etyapti (continuous)
  'has been LIVING for 8 months' -
     QANChA VAQT (continuous)
  'has BECOME a problem' - NATIJA
     (simple)

points.en: Present perfect continuous: has been living, has been sending, have been fighting, has been working, has been training, have been helping
points.uz: Present perfect continuous: has been living, has been sending, have been fighting, has been working, has been training, have been helping

points.en: Present perfect simple: have grown, have become, has treated, has been (an experience), have never felt, has already decided
points.uz: Present perfect simple: have grown, have become, has treated, has been, have never felt, has already decided

exercises.explanationUz:
NATIJA HOZIR KO'RINIB TURIBDI.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  '1 She has been walking all
   morning.'


JAVOBLAR:

  1 (oyoqlari tog'orada) → walk/all
    morning
    → She has been walking all
      morning.
  2 (kompyuterda, charchagan) →
    work/all night
    → She has been working all night.
  3 (basketbol to'pi bilan) → play
    basketball/all afternoon
    → They have been playing
      basketball all afternoon.
  4 (bo'yoq cho'tkasi) → paint/all
    day
    → He has been painting all day.
  5 (xarid xaltalari) → shop/all day
    → They have been shopping all
      day.


⚠ 'ALL MORNING/DAY/NIGHT':

  = butun ertalab/kun/tun.
  ⚠ ARTIKLSIZ: 'all day' ('all the
  day' EMAS).


⚠ 3 va 5 - KO'PLIK:

  'THEY HAVE been' - bir necha odam.


⚠ 'TO SHOP' - FE'L:

  = xarid qilmoq.
  ⚠ 'shopping' - '-pp-'.

⚠ 'They have been playing basketball all

exercises.explanationUz:
FOR va SINCE.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  FOR = DAVOMIYLIK (qancha vaqt)  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  for twenty years, for a week,
  for six months, for ages, for a
  few minutes, for two hours

  "I've been living here FOR twenty
   years."


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SINCE = BOShLANISh NUQTASI      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  since 1997, since Monday, since
  last August, since I was a child,
  since 5 o'clock

  'He has been studying English
   SINCE 1997.'


⚠ TEZ TEKShIRUV:

  'Qancha vaqt?' deb so'rasa bo'ladi
  → FOR
  'Qachondan beri?' → SINCE

  ⚠ 'since' dan keyin GAP ham kelishi
  mumkin: 'since I was a child'.


⚠ 'FOR AGES':

  = juda uzoq vaqt (so'zlashuv).
  ⚠ 'an age' = asr, davr.

points.en: We use for to express duration.
I've been living here for twenty years.
points.uz: Men bu yerda yigirma yildan beri yashayman.

points.en: We use since to state a starting point.
points.uz: 'since' ni boshlanish nuqtasini aytish uchun ishlatamiz.

points.en: He has been studying English since 1997.
points.uz: U 1997 yildan beri ingliz tilini o'rganmoqda.

exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:

  1 FOR six months (davomiylik)
  2 SINCE 1972 (yil - boshlanish)
  3 SINCE I was a child (gap -
    boshlanish)
  4 FOR ages (davomiylik)
  5 SINCE last year (boshlanish)
  6 FOR three days (davomiylik)
  7 FOR twelve years (davomiylik)
  8 SINCE last Sunday (boshlanish)


⚠ 3-BAND - 'SINCE' + GAP:

  'since I WAS a child' - 'since'
  dan keyin PAST SIMPLE gap.


⚠ 7-BAND - "JOHN'S HAD":

  "John's" = 'John HAS'.
  ⚠ 'has had' = 'have' fe'lining
  present perfect shakli - egalik
  ma'nosida continuous bo'lmaydi.


⚠ 8-BAND - "IT'S BEEN RAINING":

  "It's" = 'It HAS'.
  ⚠ Present perfect continuous.


⚠ 'TO DESIGN CLOTHES':

  = kiyim dizayni bilan shug'ullanmoq.
  ⚠ 'design' da 'g' O'QILMAYDI:
  /dɪˈzaɪn/.

items.textEn: 1 I've been designing clothes ___ six months.
2 My aunt has been a teacher ___ 1972.
3 I haven't played football ___ I was a child.
4 Chris has been talking on the telephone ___ ages!
5 Karen hasn't smoked a cigarette ___ last year.
6 We haven't seen old Mrs Brent ___ three days.
7 John's had that bike ___ twelve years.
8 I can't believe it! It's been raining ___ last Sunday!
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'last Sunday' - BOShLANISh → since.
⚠ "It's been raining" = 'It HAS been raining'.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, use the prompts to ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib savol-javob qiling, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
'HOW LONG' SAVOLLARI.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: How long have you been studying
      French?
  SB: I've been studying French for
      seven years.


⚠ SAVOL QOLIPI:

  How long have you been + -ING ...?
  ⚠ 'How long' = qancha vaqtdan beri.


⚠ JAVOBDA for/since:

  Seven years → FOR seven years
  Last August → SINCE last August
  1982 → SINCE 1982
  a few minutes → FOR a few minutes
  last month → SINCE last month
  two hours → FOR two hours


⚠ 'TO SUNBATHE':

  = quyoshda toblanmoq.
  ⚠ 'sun' + 'bathe' (cho'milmoq).


⚠ 'RACING CARS':

  = poyga mashinalari.
  ⚠ 'to drive racing cars' = poyga
  mashinasi haydamoq.

sentencePatterns.introUz: Present perfect va past simple qoliplari.

patterns.formula: Have you ever + 3-ShAKL? - Yes, I have. When? - I + PAST SIMPLE + when ...
patterns.exampleEn: Have you ever had measles? - Yes, I have. - When? - I had measles when I was five.
patterns.exampleUz: Hech qizamiq bo'lganmisiz? - Ha. - Qachon? - Besh yoshimda qizamiq bo'lganman.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Tajriba → present perfect; vaqt aytilganda
→ past simple.

patterns.exampleEn: She has been walking all morning.

patterns.formula: How long have you been + -ING? - I've been + -ING for/since ...
patterns.exampleEn: How long have you been studying French? - I've been studying French for seven years.
patterns.exampleUz: Qancha vaqtdan beri fransuz tilini o'rganyapsiz? - Yetti yildan beri.
